content.title: Is Target Open on Labor Day This Year? Everything to Know About 2025 Holiday Hours
content.text: If you're planning to shop at the bullseye this weekend, read this first to find out when Target will be open this holiday.Aug. 31, 2025, 4:00 AM CDTLabor Day falls on Monday, Sept. 1, 2025.Bloomberg via Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleLabor Day 2025 has officially arrived!It’s hard to believe, but summer is coming to a close and it’s time to turn our attention to all things autumn.Whether you’re stocking up for back-to-school supplies or all the ingredients necessary to make pumpkin bread (we see you fall fans), you’re probably wondering if Target is open on Labor Day this year so that you can shop to your heart’s content.People commonly joke that they run into Target to buy just one item and walk out with a cart full of bags. And honestly, we can relate.The store is a one-stop shop for groceries, clothing, beauty products, medicine, toys and basically anything in between if you're hoping to score a deal. If you're planning to run some errands on the Labor Day weekend and were hoping to stop by your local Target, then you might be wondering if the store is open on the holiday.TODAY.com went straight to the source to find out. Below, we're outlining what Target told us about their holiday schedule.Is Target Open On Labor Day in 2025?A Target spokesperson tells us the company's stores will be open normal business hours on Monday, Sept. 1, 2025. Since regular store hours can vary by location, customers should consult the “Find a store” feature found on Target.com.Other Stores Open on Labor Day in 2025Some stores opt to close on federal holidays, but many companies are open on Labor Day. For instance, Sam's Club will open its doors at 8 a.m. local time for Sam's Club Plus members and 10 a.m. for other club members. All locations will close early at 6 p.m. local time. Meanwhile, Walgreens will be open typical business hours on the holiday. However, Walgreens pharmacies will be closed, with the exception of 24-hour and select locations.For a full list of stores that are open on Labor Day, click here.
